data.title: Indian ‘monkey whisperers’ prepare for challenge
data.description: NEW DELHI - As top badminton players descend on New Delhi for the world championships, an unusual band of men have their eyes fixed not on the stars, but on monkeys lurking around.

data.title: Iran fires back at Trump’s Hormuz takeover threat
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran on Saturday fired back at US President Donald Trump’s claim that he would soon declare the Strait of Hormuz part of US territory, saying the crucial energy waterway it has blockaded “will remain Iranian”.

data.title: Facing drought, the Dutch rethink water management
data.description: NIJMEGEN, Netherlands - On the banks of the Waal, the Dutch branch of the Rhine, swimmers are sunning themselves on a Nijmegen beach that didn’t exist before the river level dropped a few months ago.

data.title: Powerful earthquake kills at least 20 in Indonesia
data.description: MAUMERE, East Nusa Tenggara — A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off Flores island in eastern Indonesia early Saturday, killing at least 20 people and sending thousands fleeing.

data.title: Viennese woman sues city over 'discriminatory' toilet fees
data.description: VIENNA — A Viennese woman is suing the city council for discrimination over access to public toilets, complaining that women must pay to use cubicles while men can use urinals for free.

data.title: Japan defence minister visits war shrine, PM stays away
data.description: TOKYO — Japan's defence minister paid his respects Saturday at a shrine honouring the country's war dead that has long dogged Tokyo's relations with its Asian neighbours, but Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi stayed away.

data.title: Venezuelan amputees adjust to new life after quakes
data.description: CARACAS - Teenage athlete Dennis Castillo spent 28 excruciating hours trapped under the rubble in quake-hit Venezuela, with a beam crushing her left leg as she waited to be rescued.

data.title: Venezuela frees more political prisoners amid post-Maduro talks
data.description: CARACAS - Venezuela freed dozens more political prisoners Friday, the government said, in a sign of progress in talks to reconcile the nation following Nicolas Maduro's ouster.

data.title: Ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism scandal found dead
data.description: LONDON - Black academic Jason Arday, who resigned from the University of Cambridge last week amid a high-profile plagiarism storm that featured racism claims, was found dead Friday, the prestigious British institution confirmed.

data.title: Powerful quake off Indonesia kills one, sparks mass evacuations
data.description: MAUMERE — A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off Flores island in eastern Indonesia early Saturday, killing at least one person and sending thousands fleeing.

data.title: Poweful quake off Indonesia sparks mass evacuations
data.description: MAUMERE (INDONESIA) - A strong 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off Flores island in eastern Indonesia early Saturday, sending thousands running in panic after authorities issued a tsunami warning.

data.title: Trump dismisses concerns over conditions on US aircraft carrier
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump dismissed concerns Friday over living conditions and the mental health of service members on a US aircraft carrier deployed against Iran and said the ship would soon rotate out.

data.title: Colombia hopes for miracles as search for quake victims goes on
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - The chances of finding earthquake survivors in Colombia dropped significantly on Friday, four days after the 7.4-magnitude tremor struck, though rescue efforts plowed ahead as hundreds remained missing.

data.title: Homeless, jobless: Colombia quake survivors 'left with nothing'
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Nine-year-old Sebastian paints a portrait of his family home, unable to comprehend that it no longer exists after the powerful quake that shattered western Colombia this week.

data.title: Zambia suspends vote counting, citing violence
data.description: LUSAKA - Zambia suspended vote counting nationwide on Friday following reports of violence in some districts, the electoral commission said.

data.title: Europe battles wildfires: latest developments
data.description: PARIS - Countries across Europe were battling a wave of new wildfires Friday as blistering temperatures and tinder-dry landscapes made for dangerous conditions.

data.title: NATO jets shoot down drone in Latvian airspace
data.description: RIGA - NATO said on Friday that its fighter jets shot down a drone that entered Latvian airspace, the latest incursion along the military alliance’s eastern flank bordering Russia.

data.title: Exiled Putin critic says push for peace put him in danger
data.description: PARIS - Veteran Russian politician Boris Nadezhdin never planned to flee to France.

data.title: Is a new conflict brewing in northern Ethiopia?
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - A recent flare-up in tensions in Ethiopia’s Tigray, including reports of heavy artillery battles and drone strikes, has raised fears of a return to war in the northern state — a conflict potentially stoked by foreign nations.

data.title: Farage wins UK by-election as Count Binface claims 'moral victory'
data.description: CLACTON-ON-SEA (UNITED KINGDOM) - Hard-right British politician Nigel Farage was re-elected to his parliamentary seat Friday in a by-election shunned by the major parties -- handing his main rival, joke candidate Count Binface, a larger than expected share of the vote.

data.title: China's viral 'spicy strips' take a bite of global snack market
data.description: PINGJIANG (CHINA) - At a gleaming new factory in China's central hinterland, masked workers in white uniform season and sift through mounds of latiao, a longtime popular snack that has found hungry fans overseas.
